summary: Quick frontend check after lint-only edits, on a 390x844 mobile web preview with the approved QA learner (7004186276). Everything passed. Sign-in works. Home shows home-screen, home-brand, home-header and home-exam-grid (JEE MAIN/PYQ, BITSAT, COMEDK, ALL INDIA/LIVE) with no red screen. Solo Sprint: card 1 of 30 appears, timer counts down (15 -> 12 after 2.5s), answering shows feedback, Next moves to card 2, Skip works, Exit -> Finish shows the summary with the right counts, and Done returns to the arena. Practice Rival: countdown and entry show appear, play screen shows the score board and a 15s ring, all 30 cards answered with a verdict on each, and the result screen shows VICTORY 11-10 with Done / Play again. No new console errors after sign-in. The only error was one expected 401 from the session check before sign-in. No academic test paper was touched. No accounts were created.
